seed: MP2 (top-256 doubles + HF), no circuit sampling
status: PARTIAL — stopped at growth iter 2 per the pre-agreed 15-min/iteration stop rule; latest COMPLETED iteration is iter 1. NOT a converged run, NOT a pass.
why_stopped: MP2-seed path was chosen after measuring that the 40q tensornet-mps CIRCUIT sampler has a large fixed MPS-contraction cost (~independent of shots: 200k->9549s; 2k still sampling at 22 min) that starves the growth phase. Growth is seed-source-independent (committed 28q CPU pre-validation used the same MP2 seed; GPU sampler already proven exact at 20q/28q). Growth iter 1 (seed 257 -> 30257 dets) took 551s; iter 2 (30257 -> ~60257 dets) exceeded 15 min and was stopped per the agreed rule. The durable per-iteration checkpoint preserves iter 1 exactly.

P1_chem_acc_le_1p6_mHa.note: Improving fast (seed +100 mHa -> iter1 +8.94 mHa); not converged, not a pass. Reported as-is.

P2_det_band_3e5_4e6.note: Below the [3e5,4e6] band at the stop point; the schedule targets it (30k/iter, kcap 1.5M) but was stopped by the 15-min/iter wall before reaching it.

P3_mem_lt_8gb_device.note: This MP2-seed path performs no MPS sampling, so there is no tensornet-mps device footprint to judge. (Attempt-1's true tensornet-mps device peak was 12.06 GB > 8 GB; that P3 question is unchanged and separate.)

comparison_to_attempt1.improvement: ~5x the determinants (30257 vs 6108) at ~0.60x the error (8.94 vs 14.82 mHa) — a much-improved partial, as expected. Still not a pass.

honesty_statement: Reported exactly as measured from the durable per-iteration checkpoint. No threshold moved; nothing tuned after seeing results. This is a substantially improved 40q partial (fast incremental engine + MP2 seed), not a converged chemical-accuracy result. The remaining barrier is now the per-iteration eigensolve cost at large subspace size (iter 2 at ~6e4 dets exceeded 15 min), which bounds how many determinants are reachable in a GPU day even with the incremental Hamiltonian.
